_meta.note: 部署配方来自 bench/ 目录里真正跑通的脚本与日志（AutoDL 按量机器：RTX 4090 西北B区、RTX 5090 北京B区、A800 80GB 北京B区）。命令与版本号照抄自 setup_autodl.sh / run_matrix.sh / adapters/*.py；坑位来自逐模型日志。只陈述我们遇到与解决的问题，不评价模型。

machine.zh: AutoDL 按量实例，镜像 PyTorch 2.5.1 + CUDA 12.4（miniconda，Python 3.12），数据盘 50 GB 挂在 /root/autodl-tmp
machine.en: AutoDL pay-as-you-go instance, image PyTorch 2.5.1 + CUDA 12.4 (miniconda, Python 3.12), 50 GB data disk at /root/autodl-tmp

common.zh: pip 换华为云镜像。同机房实测华为云 8 MB/s，阿里云与清华只有 KB 级。
common.en: Point pip at the Huawei Cloud mirror. Measured 8 MB/s from that datacenter; Aliyun and Tsinghua mirrors only did KB/s there.
common.cmd: pip config set global.index-url https://repo.huaweicloud.com/repository/pypi/simple && pip config set global.trusted-host repo.huaweicloud.com

common.zh: 权重走 hf-mirror.com，缓存放数据盘，并关掉 Xet 传输（镜像上 Xet 会 401 或卡死），再卸载 hf_xet。
common.en: Fetch weights through hf-mirror.com, keep the cache on the data disk, and disable Xet transfer (it 401s or stalls on the mirror); uninstall hf_xet as well.
common.cmd: export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/hf HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && pip uninstall -y hf_xet hf-xet

common.zh: 不同模型要求的 transformers 版本互相冲突，按组建 venv（--system-site-packages 共享系统 torch）：openvla 组 4.40.1、spatialvla 组 4.47.0、qwen 组 4.57.1；lerobot 要 torch ≥ 2.7，单独建完整 venv。
common.en: Models pin conflicting transformers versions, so build one venv per group (sharing the system torch via --system-site-packages): openvla group 4.40.1, spatialvla group 4.47.0, qwen group 4.57.1; lerobot needs torch ≥ 2.7 and gets its own full venv.

common.zh: 大权重先串行下完再跑；镜像上 7B 级权重要 20–40 分钟，并行下会互相拖慢。下载加重试循环。跑成功后删该模型权重，50 GB 数据盘放不下第二个 7B。
common.en: Download large weights sequentially before running; a 7B checkpoint takes 20–40 min on the mirror and parallel downloads slow each other down. Wrap the download in a retry loop. Delete the weights after a successful run: the 50 GB disk will not hold a second 7B model.
common.cmd: for i in 1 2 3 4; do python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; s('<repo>')" && break; sleep 15; done

common.zh: SSH 会话会断，长任务用 nohup 起并 disown；结束进程用精确匹配（pgrep -f "^/root/envs/..."），pkill -f 会连自己的 shell 一起杀。
common.en: SSH sessions drop. Start long jobs with nohup and disown; kill by exact match (pgrep -f "^/root/envs/...") because a loose pkill -f takes your own shell down too.

common.zh: RTX 5090（Blackwell，sm_120）跑不了镜像自带的 torch 2.5.1；先升到 torch 2.8.0（cu128）。setup_autodl.sh 会自动判断。
common.en: The RTX 5090 (Blackwell, sm_120) cannot run the image's torch 2.5.1; upgrade to torch 2.8.0 (cu128) first. setup_autodl.sh detects this automatically.

weights.note_zh: VLM 底座，策略加载时会再拉一次
weights.note_en: VLM backbone, pulled again when the policy loads

recipes.load_zh: lerobot.policies.factory 加载策略后，用 make_pre_post_processors 建预处理流水线；每步输出 50 步动作块（flow matching 10 步去噪）。
recipes.load_en: Load the policy via lerobot.policies.factory, then build the pre/post-processing pipeline with make_pre_post_processors; each step emits a 50-step action chunk (flow matching, 10 denoising steps).

pitfalls.zh: KeyError 'tokens' 之类的分词错误：lerobot 0.6 起把分词与归一化挪进了预处理流水线，不能直接把原始 batch 喂给 select_action。
pitfalls.en: Tokenizer KeyErrors: since lerobot 0.6 tokenisation and normalisation live in the preprocessing pipeline; do not feed a raw batch straight into select_action.

pitfalls.zh: "Reducing the number of VLM layers to 16" 与 torch_dtype 弃用提示是正常输出，不是错误。
pitfalls.en: "Reducing the number of VLM layers to 16" and the torch_dtype deprecation notice are normal output, not errors.

recipes.load_zh: AutoModelForVision2Seq + AutoProcessor，trust_remote_code=True，low_cpu_mem_usage=True；输出 7 个离散动作 token。
recipes.load_en: AutoModelForVision2Seq + AutoProcessor with trust_remote_code=True and low_cpu_mem_usage=True; outputs 7 discrete action tokens.

pitfalls.zh: 新版 transformers 下远程代码报错（processor / tokenizer 接口变了）。
pitfalls.en: Remote code breaks on newer transformers (processor / tokenizer interfaces changed).

pitfalls.zh: 启动时打印 "The cache for model files in Transformers v4.22.0 has been updated"。
pitfalls.en: Startup prints "The cache for model files in Transformers v4.22.0 has been updated".
pitfalls.fix_zh: 一次性缓存迁移提示，忽略。

recipes.load_zh: AutoModel + AutoProcessor，trust_remote_code=True；反归一化键 unnorm_key 必须是模型统计表里存在的键。
recipes.load_en: AutoModel + AutoProcessor with trust_remote_code=True; the unnorm_key must exist in the model's statistics table.

pitfalls.fix_zh: pip install scipy（README 没写，远程代码要用）。
pitfalls.fix_en: pip install scipy (not listed in the README, but the remote code imports it).

pitfalls.fix_zh: 从 processor.statistics 或 model.statistics 里取一个存在的键；没有就跳过反归一化。
pitfalls.fix_en: Pick a key present in processor.statistics or model.statistics; skip un-normalisation if there is none.

pitfalls.zh: HybridCache batch_size 弃用警告、"Add 0 TRANSLATION TOKENS" 等输出。
pitfalls.en: HybridCache batch_size deprecation warning and "Add 0 TRANSLATION TOKENS" lines.

recipes.load_zh: AutoModelForImageTextToText + AutoProcessor，trust_remote_code=True；每步生成 16 个动作 token。
recipes.load_en: AutoModelForImageTextToText + AutoProcessor with trust_remote_code=True; generates 16 action tokens per step.

pitfalls.zh: ModuleNotFoundError: transformers —— 镜像偶发拿不到 4.57.1（"from versions: none"），venv 建好了但包没装上。
pitfalls.en: ModuleNotFoundError: transformers — the mirror occasionally fails to serve 4.57.1 ("from versions: none"), leaving the venv without the package.
pitfalls.fix_zh: 跑前用 python -c "import transformers" 验一遍；失败换清华或官方源重装。
pitfalls.fix_en: Verify with python -c "import transformers" before running; on failure reinstall from the Tsinghua or official index.

pitfalls.fix_zh: 用 4.57.1 的 qwen 组环境，不要和 OpenVLA 混装。
pitfalls.fix_en: Use the 4.57.1 qwen-group venv; do not mix with the OpenVLA venv.

weights.note_zh: 32 个文件；镜像上要 40 分钟以上，务必单独串行下
weights.note_en: 32 files; 40+ minutes on the mirror, download alone and sequentially

recipes.load_zh: AutoModelForImageTextToText + AutoProcessor，trust_remote_code=True；每步生成 64 个 token（含推理轨迹），所以延迟明显高于其它模型。
recipes.load_en: AutoModelForImageTextToText + AutoProcessor with trust_remote_code=True; generates 64 tokens per step (including a reasoning trace), hence much higher latency than the others.

pitfalls.zh: attn_implementation 为 None 报错：嵌套子配置（vision / adapter / llm）不继承顶层的注意力实现。
pitfalls.en: Error about attn_implementation being None: the nested sub-configs (vision / adapter / llm) do not inherit the top-level attention implementation.
pitfalls.fix_zh: 加载前对每个子配置设 _attn_implementation="sdpa"。
pitfalls.fix_en: Set _attn_implementation="sdpa" on each sub-config before loading.

pitfalls.zh: 数据盘写满导致下载中断、其它模型权重被挤掉。
pitfalls.en: Data disk fills up, aborting the download and evicting other weights.
pitfalls.fix_zh: 下 MolmoAct 前先删掉已跑完模型的权重；只在 50 GB 盘上留它一个。
pitfalls.fix_en: Delete weights of finished models before downloading MolmoAct; keep only this one on the 50 GB disk.

pitfalls.fix_zh: snapshot_download 放进重试循环，断点续传会接着下。
pitfalls.fix_en: Wrap snapshot_download in a retry loop; it resumes from where it stopped.

not_reproduced.zh: 需要 Google PaliGemma 分词器，Hugging Face 上要先申请并接受许可（gated），我们的镜像通道拿不到。
not_reproduced.en: Needs the Google PaliGemma tokenizer, which is gated on Hugging Face (licence acceptance required); not reachable through the mirror route.

not_reproduced.zh: 同 π0：PaliGemma 分词器为 gated 资源。
not_reproduced.en: Same as π0: the PaliGemma tokenizer is gated.

not_reproduced.zh: 权重是 prismatic 格式，需要 openvla-mini 仓库自己的运行时，不是 transformers 远程代码；第一阶段未装。
not_reproduced.en: Weights are in the prismatic format and need the openvla-mini runtime rather than transformers remote code; not set up in phase one.

not_reproduced.zh: 同 MiniVLA：依赖 prismatic 运行时。
not_reproduced.en: Same as MiniVLA: depends on the prismatic runtime.
